featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Dooa
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visit Dairy Cone in Matunga quite often and usually have a good experience, which is why today’s interaction was disappointing.

I ordered an icecream sandwich and asked the staff member to cut it in half. After cutting it, he wrapped the halves in tissue paper. Since sandwiches here have normally been served to us on a plate, I politely asked if it could be given on a plate instead.

The staff member responded rudely, saying “pehle bolna chahiye tha na,” and then said that they only serve it on a plate when the owner is present because the owner tells them to do so. When I mentioned that we come here often and have received it on a plate many times, he started arguing and even said they normally don’t cut sandwiches in half either (which they always do)

Later when the owner arrived, we tried to explain what had happened. Instead of calmly addressing the issue, the staff member continued arguing and said that we were not explaining things correctly. He even arrogantly said he would show the CCTV footage to prove his point. The owner simply dismissed the situation by telling the staff member to drop it when he brought up the CCTV thing.

Another staff member was present during the entire interaction and had witnessed everything, but he remained silent throughout.

As regular customers, this experience was disappointing. The taste here is decent, but customer service and basic courtesy should be consistent regardless of whether the owner is present or not.

Believe me its very rare.
Outlet is done very nice and they are not as small as other ice cream places. Green colour looks wow in their interiors. They got, sorbets, kulfies and ice creams with many flavours in fruit, nuts and chocolate based. You can taste taste their ice creams which will help you to choose the best one. We tried 4 flavours like motichoor laddu icecream (Special for ganapati festival), sugar free kesar pista, coffee and paan.
Motichur laddu flavour was super hit, spcial for ganapati festival had good amount of bundi in it and balanced taste of saffron and sweetness was just perfect. Must order and would request them to keep this flavour 36 days in their menu.
Paan flavour is again was one of the best. Enjoyed it.
Next time I will try their shakes and even the pani puri sorbet which I coudnt try. Yes don’t miss their guava on which they sprinkle spicy seasoning. From now onwards I would order from apsara on regular bases for sure. Thanks to the team for such a warm experience.

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Albal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let me start straight — the attitude at this place is ruining what could otherwise be a great shop.
I’ve been visiting since childhood. Back when the father used to sit at the counter, there was warmth, humility, and genuine respect for customers. That’s how this place built its reputation.
Now? Completely different story.
The son who currently handles the counter is shockingly rude, ill-mannered, and arrogant. The way he speaks to customers feels dismissive and disrespectful — like he’s doing you a favor by serving you. Ask about flavors and you’ll either get a half-hearted answer or visible irritation. He doesn’t properly explain the menu and often seems like he doesn’t even know it well himself.
Let’s be clear — the ice cream still tastes great. I’ve always loved the flavors, and quality-wise, it’s still solid.
But customer service matters. A business doesn’t survive on taste alone. If the person representing the shop lacks basic courtesy and communication skills, loyal customers will eventually stop coming.
It’s disappointing to see a place with so much history slowly being dragged down by poor behavior at the counter.
Fix the attitude, or the shop’s future doesn’t look very bright.

featured_reviews.name: Aatmi
featured_reviews.review_text:

The soft serve is consistently delicious, and they usually have seating available, which is a nice bonus. The machines are almost always working too, so you can count on them being ready to serve.

Some of my favorite treats include the chocolate chip soft serve, chocolate/Strawberry soft serve, vanilla with chocolate syrup, 2-flavoured soft serve, the chocolate ice cream and the chocolate brownie sundae. Everything I’ve tried here has been fantastic!

A heads-up: they only accept cash—no cards—so make sure you’re prepared.

featured_reviews.name: Loyson Louis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Baba Falooda – Sitladevi Mandir Metro (Personal Review)
Rating: 2.5–3/5
What I liked:
Rich and generous faloodas loaded with rose syrup, sabja seeds, ice cream, kulfi pieces, and other toppings.
Fresh juices are decent.
The staff appear to make a sincere effort to maintain cleanliness despite being a roadside outlet.
Convenient if you're in the area and craving something cold and sweet.
What I didn't like:
No seating at all; everything is standing-room only.
Being a roadside stall, the entire preparation and serving area is exposed to traffic, dust, and pedestrians.
Presentation is basic—ingredients are packed into the glass without much finesse, and you practically have to "excavate" your falooda with a plastic spoon.
Prices are on the higher side (around ₹100+ per serving).
The constant presence of beggars approaching customers while they're eating can make the experience uncomfortable, especially when dining with a group.
Better alternatives nearby:
Badshah – Better ambience, seating, air-conditioned comfort, and a more enjoyable overall experience for falooda and cold beverages.
Gupta Kulfi Centre – Located opposite Baba Falooda, with air-conditioning and a more comfortable environment, even though space is limited.
Verdict: If you're thirsty and happen to be passing by, Baba Falooda can satisfy a craving for a rich, heavily loaded falooda. However, if comfort, ambience, presentation, and a relaxed experience matter to you, I'd personally choose Badshah ( Crawford market ) or the nearby Gupta Kulfi Centre instead.
"Good in an emergency, but not a destination I'd specifically visit for a falooda."

featured_reviews.name: Mithil Thakker
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a small outlet with limited seating indoor however they have kept a few chairs outdoor as well.

Staff is very polite and will guide you through their best Desserts if inquired.

Let's take you on a ride of what all we savored out here.

Mahabaleshwar Strawberry Cream :
There is no need to Travel till Mahabaleshwar if the heavenly and delightful Strawberry Cream is offered in our very own city . Do try this creamy Delicacy of the outlet before this strawberry season ends .

• Strawberry Fantasy Pastry
Chocolate pastry with the goodness of fresh strawberry bites in between. The combination really works great for us

• Thandai Ice Cream and Thandai Shake
We strongly recommend this luscious Shake and Ice cream of the outlet . It has some real Flavours of Thandai which was too good to be missed . All Thandai lovers must definitely try at least one if the two .

• Red Velvet Cold Stone
A Scrumptious combo of  valentino ice cream, cheese cream and red velvet cubes. All of those blended immaculately on a Cold Stone till it formed a consistent creamy delight.  We will visit this place again just to enjoy this supreme and our all time favorite ice cream .

We really enjoyed our dessert experience at Oasiss and will definitely recommend all of  you to explore their wide range of desserts.

featured_reviews.name: Sherilyn Pires
featured_reviews.review_text:
This cute dessert parlour is located in Matunga East. Their menu includes everything delicious, ranging from waffles to shakes to ice-creams and colourful pastries.

I tried their famous Charcoal black cold stone ice-cream and it was absolutely drool-worthy. Subtle hints of coconut in chocolate is exactly what you'll find in every bite. Its a must try.

With the strawberry season on in full swing, why not indulge in some of their strawberry delicacies?

The cocoberry waffle contains fresh strawberry pieces and oodles of chocolate sauce on top of a crisp, golden brown waffle. Need I say anymore?

And my favourite was the Mahabaleshwar and cream. A blend of smooth and creamy whipped cream with strawberry sauce and crunchy pieces of strawberry. This dessert surely celebrates the strawberry season. Its totally delicious and heavenly!

And finally, their oreo madness shake is filled with the goodness of crushed oreos, chocolate sauce and milk. Could have been a wee bit thicker.

A lovely place to satisfy your dessert cravings. Do visit!

featured_reviews.name: Voracious Blogger
featured_reviews.review_text:
Starting with the ambience - The place was comfortable but on weekends there is quite rush there and the seating tables are only 4 chairs available with 2 tables !
The ambience was very very pretty . The walls were beautifully designed with the desserts quotes and the colours on the walls were pretty attractive.
I tried the special mango menu there in which i tried :
1) Mango Maharaja : It consisted The tasty and cold Mango Icecream , Vanilla Whipped Cream and The king of all fruits : Mango pieces. It was layered beautifully and tasted very well . It was the first thing i tried and felt very tasty so tried many other mango items there.

2) Choco Mango waffle : Made with perfection it consisted the crispy waffle , having the layer of nutella chocolate and over it were the mango pieces! The taste of mango pieces was going perfectly with the nutella chocolate.

3) Mango Shake : The taste of the mango shake was not too sweet . It tasted really like a pure mango milkshake made with mangoes.

4) Mango popsicle : It was made of the Mango icecream and for the toppings there were many options, first i selected the layer of dark chocolate (there were 2 options : dark chocolate or white chocolate) then in toppings i seleced
i) Red velvet crush of the cube ii) Cadbury gems iii) White choco chips
And finally after the toppings there was a sweet white chocolate drizzle which made it look attractive

5)Mango detox icecream with rainbow cone: The Scoop of Mango detox icecream was good and was above expectations
The cone had a good crisp and was multicoloured

6) Banarasiya Paan shake : The Banarasiya Paan shake which is named perfectly with its taste . It was made with perfection but but i felt it a little more weet then expected.

featured_reviews.name: Kkomal Maru
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had heard so much about Oasiss Desserts. Before today never got an opportunity to visit Oasiss Outlet.

Today being my niece’ birthday I was looking for a cake shop. While passing by Matunga stopped 3/4 cakeshops but I decided to go to Oasiss as I had always heard so much about it.

The store has pleasant ambience.

Store staff is also good.

I just asked them for non chocolate cakes and they had plenty of options in that.

I asked them to suggest their best cake and I was suggested “Rasmalai Cake” & spontaneously decided to buy it.

After coming back home & after cutting the cake when we had the cake, I couldn’t believe this tasted so bad. Totally artificial taste with so much of essence taste. Taste wise it terribly let me down. Not that I have never had Rasmalai Cake in my life. In fact I have had best rasmalai that too at a lesser cost than Oassis cake. if their best is this bad, I don’t know how their other cakes gonna be.

This cake costed 710/- Taste wise disappointing. I feel so bad now that I bought this cake for my niece’ birthday. I also paid 10 Rs extra for getting my niece’ name on a chocolate. The photo I am attaching I after hiding name of my niece.

This place has let me down & spoiled one of important day for my family.

Only good part for buying cake here is they give cake knife, candle and paper bag without additional cost.

I have never been so prompt in reviewing a place, but today I had to. I don’t think I will ever visit any Oassis outlet again. My day is ended on a bad note. Sigh

featured_reviews.name: anne pires
featured_reviews.review_text:
Oasiss Desserts situated at Matunga East is a small outlet with a bright and welcoming ambiance with quirky quotes on the walls.

The staff were friendly and polite. Being dessert lovers we couldn't wait to try out their wide variety of desserts. Currently with the Strawwberry festival going on here's what we tried.

Mahableshwar Cream - A mixture of fresh cream, fresh strawberries pieces and Strawberry syrup. Absolutely delicious and and beautifully presented. A must try here!

Coco Berry Waffle - The waffle was served warm, topped with with Chocolate and Strawberry syrup and fresh Strawberry pieces. Great combination of waffles and fruits. A heavenly dessert and we couldn't stop having it.

Charcoal Black Cold Stone ice cream - A scoop of ice cream with a mixture of oreo, choco chips and chololate sauce. A delicious and unique ice cream served in a black cone. Loved it. A must have.

Oreo Madness Milkshake - It was an oreo milkshake with pieces of crushed oreo. Tasted good.

Oasiss Desserts is your one stop destination for some awesome desserts.
